$comment: Income distributions fitted to the ADRH. A dataset without a variable: not a map layer (a distribution's parameters say nothing on a map), but what a unit's detail draws its distribution from.

datasets.title: Distribución de la renta por unidad de consumo, ajustada a una Dagum (a partir del Atlas de distribución de renta de los hogares)

source.method: Dagum distribution F(x) = (1 + (x/b)^-a)^-p of the population by net income per consumption unit, fitted by weighted least squares to each unit's published shares below and above nine thresholds, median, mean, Gini index and P80/P20 ratio (INE's top and bottom codes as soft bounds, a weak prior on the shape); units with too few published figures inherit the nearest unit above's fit, else their own in the nearest year
